display.purpose: The 'Good morning, Collins' greeting only — largest, most dominant line on any screen.

title.purpose: Section headings and anchor values inside stat cards.

label.purpose: Stat-card captions, chip text, muted metadata.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Hover/focus background-lightness transitions only; never on layout properties.

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: One of three equal-hierarchy dashboard cards (Properties / Tenants / Revenue). Flat panel, one lightness step above page, hairline border, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-stat-card { background: #1c2117; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 10px; padding: 20px; } .ds-stat-label { font: 500 0.8125rem/1.3 Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #9aa092; margin: 0 0 6px; } .ds-stat-value { font: 600 1.5rem/1.2 Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #ececea; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; margin: 0; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button. Flat Envato Green fill, 8px radius, no pill, no glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #5fa33c; color: #15190f; font: 600 0.9375rem/1 Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #6cb449; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(95,163,60,0.5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Status indicator (paid / due soon / due today / overdue / notice / vacant). Flat fill at reduced opacity, no border, no glow.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font: 500 0.8125rem/1.3 Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-chip-overdue { background: rgba(224,86,69,0.18); color: #f0a398; }

narrative.overview: Nestwell is being pivoted away from its original Revolut-flavored softness toward something that reads like a tool built for someone who runs real numbers every day: flat, structured, Airtable-adjacent. The surface stays quiet, dark, tinted-neutral panels with a single confident green doing the talking, so that the only thing competing for attention is the data itself: who owes rent, who's due today, what's collected this month. This system explicitly rejects the project's own starting point: oversized glowing hero numbers, heavy pill/bubble chrome, and soft drop-shadow bloom.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, dark-mode-first panels, tinted toward the brand green rather than true black/grey.
One accent color (Envato-style green) used sparingly: primary actions, the one metric that should pop, status chips.
Equal-weight stat cards instead of one oversized hero number.
Tight corners (6-10px) and hairline borders instead of 20px pill-soft radii.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow carries visual weight anywhere in this system. Depth is one lightness step plus a 1px hairline border.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Envato Green appears on primary actions, one hero metric, and status-chip fills only.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every Naira figure and numeric count renders with tabular-nums.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: Buttons, badges, and cards never emit a colored glow.

dos: Do keep every panel one lightness step above the page background, with a 1px hairline border.
Do keep Envato Green confined to primary actions, the one hero metric, and chip fills.
Do render every stat card at the same visual weight.
Do use tabular figures on every Naira amount and count.
donts: Don't reintroduce Revolut-style softness: oversized glowing hero numbers, heavy pill/bubble chrome, soft drop-shadow bloom.
Don't use box-shadow for elevation anywhere.
Don't use gradient-text for any metric or heading.
Don't build rows of identical icon+heading+text filler cards.
Don't reach for a modal/bottom-sheet as the first answer for tenant/room detail.
Don't use border-left/border-right as a colored accent stripe.
